encounter.text: A rat with eyes that glow faintly blue blinks at you, then shakes their head hard. 'Sorry. I keep — drifting. There's something in the deeper Warrens. A smell, or a sound, or neither — something that makes you want to walk toward it and not stop.' They sit down heavily. 'Three of my group didn't come back. I watched them walk away with the same expression. Calm. Decided.' They look at you directly. 'Don't go alone.'
